verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's own developer docs offer a separate developer sandbox account for testing in a risk-free environment. Because it is a separate account rather than a dry-run mode, it provides true sandbox isolation from production data. However, this rests on a single brief docs mention with no detail. Missing for 10: documentation of how the sandbox is provisioned and isolated from production, whether it carries test or seed data, its limits and parity with production (API, MCP, automations), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Create a developer sandbox account ... Testing in a risk-free environment.
